summary: {person} brings a riders’ letter to the two supervisors who lead the transit committee.
realLife: Milwaukee’s Transit Plus advisory minutes record a council-reviewed letter to the committee chair and vice chair and the chair’s commitment to oppose paratransit cuts.
gates: An advisory body has sent a reviewed letter to the responsible committee.
weights: A vote approaching before the next advisory meeting favors a written response.
inGame: needs: advisory letter, recipients, attributed reply and pending budget.

turns.what: Riders ask which amendment will carry it.
turns.pulledBy: The chair replies with a commitment.
turns.writesBack: Link the promise to the pending measure.

turns.what: The advisory council collects riders’ trip accounts.
turns.writesBack: Append the accounts to the correspondence.
